title: New $76m hub helps agencies enter 'chat room' to disrupt youth extremism
paragraphs: A new Counter Terrorism Online Centre opening in Sydney will help Australia's top spy and policing agencies detect and disrupt youth radicalisation before it leads to real-world violence.
The counterterrorism hub's opening comes amid a spike in young people being charged with terrorism offences.
The government is open to further legislative changes to help police and intelligence agencies crack down on youth extremism.
